rules.title: EN 引脚低电平关闭芯片，不得悬空

evidence.quote: Low: off, the chip powers off.
Note: Do not leave the EN pin floating.

rules.title: EN 的 RC 延时电路的最终数值（图 9-1 中 R1、C2 标为 TBD）

execution.reason: a rule that is unknown is never executed

rules.missing: Figure 9-1 of the module datasheet v1.8 (page 41) shows R1 and C2 of the EN circuit as "TBD". The text of the same page and the Hardware Design Guidelines say "usually R = 10 kΩ and C = 1 µF" and tell the designer to adjust the values to the power-up timing of the module and the chip (rule C-ESP-NEED-RESET keeps the usual values as a recommendation). The final values depend on the supply ramp of the project, which no document gives: the project has to decide them and test the power-up.

rules.title: USB 差分对：90 Ω ±10%，平行等长走线

evidence.quote: Use differential pairs and route them in parallel at equal lengths. Maintain a differential pair impedance of 90 Ω with a tolerance of ±10%.
GPIO19 and GPIO20 can be used as D- and D+ of USB respectively.

execution.reason: fastroute: no spacing, skew or length parameter to hand to the router

rules.title: USB 差分对的线间距

execution.reason: a rule that is unknown is never executed

rules.missing: The gap between the two traces depends on the stack-up and the trace width; the documents read give the 90 Ω target but no spacing. The stack-up of the board is needed (the plugin's impedance tool can derive widths from it).

rules.title: USB 差分对的长度差上限

execution.reason: a rule that is unknown is never executed

rules.missing: The PCB Layout Design guideline says to route the pair "in parallel at equal lengths" and gives no number. No document read for this pack gives a skew limit in millimetres; do not use a typical value.
